payload.body: GO 155 (light), utilz-cc: 153's run on the fixed bytes, beside dc's heavy 154. A good catch, and the right fix. Because it widens path_without, which every caller uses, two more things are needed. (1) In 155, add M5 again, path_without leaving one of several tools in, so the multi-tool form is proven to hide each tool it names. (2) 0084's heavy landing run takes the utilz suite whole on both bashes, beside install_e2e, since a 142 on the old candidate does not cover the new path_without. Also, a stash in the shared repo is visible from every worktree and the primary. Keep rehearsals out of git stash, in a scratch clone, as your landings already are.
